verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs mention Semantic Search, Natural Language Search, and 'Typesense for AI Agents' as thin one-line topics, but there is no evidence of the product itself generating AI-driven insights or suggestions from indexed data — it remains a search/retrieval engine that other systems can query, not an analytics tool that surfaces its own AI-generated commentary. Missing for 10: any documented feature where Typesense proactively analyzes data and produces insights/suggestions, UI showing such output, or independent confirmation of this capability.
